Initial browser check could not resolve playwright: workspace has no package under that name.
Used installed Codex playwright-core via an artifact-only module loader; no project dependency changed.
Historical arena-picker fixture was outdated: mandatory player details and current newspaper blocked input,
level bands exposed one initial room rather than the old ungrouped three, and icon/button heights differ.
Fixture now prepares a named player, closes visible newspaper, explicitly tests the ungrouped picker while
separate integration tests cover level groups, and compares button centers rather than top edges.
Historical test expected a removed selected-arena tooltip and separate Play click. Current choose() enters
the arena immediately; test now verifies actual room entry, return to lobby, retained choice after reload,
and redirect when an arena fills between listing and clicking. Product UI was not changed for these tests.
All intermediate failure logs retained. Final browser-capacity-join.txt: 3 engines, 51 layouts, pass.
Linux full source 59970e2: 2328 tests, 2327 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip. Runtime source 3d71479 differs from
59970e2 only in this browser fixture. Production runtime/config files are identical between the commits.
Planning calculator and docs are separate later work, not part of the full runtime test claim.
Read-only commands with incorrect root-vs-active documentation paths failed; corrected paths were used.
Two bounded 40-second startup readiness polls expired while the full world was loading. The process
remained active with NRestarts=0; the next poll succeeded with PostgreSQL healthy and manual maintenance.
These polls are startup waiting evidence, not failed functional tests or an unexpected restart.
